features: Adds reusable BDC Judge Directory master table with permanent Judge IDs
Judge identity supports full name, country, country code, photo URL, Instagram, email, status and notes
Adds judge directory management screen and reusable judge search endpoint
Adds judge_id reference support to both Real and Test scoring judge assignments
Existing name-only judge assignments are backfilled into the shared Judge Directory without changing their round assignment
Judge projection now queries master judge identity and displays photo, flag/country, scope and Chief Judge status
Judge identity is shared while Test and Real scoring assignments remain isolated
No scoring calculation, results or official BDC points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
